config.anomaly_definition: ground-truth label (anomaly_label.csv); flagged_retention reports the model's own Anomaly calls

retention_definitions.weighted_retention: (HOT anomalies + sum over WARM anomalies of warm_credit * min(1, lines_kept / (warm_ref_fraction * lines))) / all anomalies -- used by fitness and the target

model.fitted_on: every labeled block (both halves are in-sample)
